query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE claim_reference IS NULL OR claim_reference = 'NULL') as claims_missing_reference,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims WHERE insurer_tenant_id IS NULL) as claims_missing_tenant,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_assessments a LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.id = a.claim_id WHERE c.id IS NULL) as orphan_assessments,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim_approvals ca LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.id = ca.claim_id WHERE c.id IS NULL) as orphan_approvals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim_documents cd LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.id = cd.claim_id WHERE c.id IS NULL) as orphan_documents,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim_review_queue rq LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.id = rq.claim_id WHERE c.id IS NULL) as orphan_queue_items,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE insurer_tenant_id IS NULL AND role NOT IN ('platform_super_admin','platform_admin','kinga_admin')) as users_missing_tenant;
